# WH14K: Rules (EN)
These rules apply to all players and staff. By playing here, you agree to follow them.
## Source and compliance We follow the Space Station 14 Hub Rules: https://docs.spacestation14.com/en/community/space-wizards-hub-rules.html
If wording differs, the official Hub Rules text has priority.
## Zero tolerance for 18+ content [color=#ff0000]This project is not 18+.[/color] [color=#ff0000]ERP, sexual content, and sexual shock content are prohibited.[/color]
## Hub Rules (detailed summary) ### Section 1 (high severity) - 1.1 No harassment, bullying, brigading, defamation, or doxxing of players, developers, or communities. - 1.2 No illegal actions under United States law: unauthorized access, DDoS, malware, phishing, license violations. - 1.3 Do not use player hardware or connection for non-game purposes. - 1.4 Servers with mature themes must be clearly marked as 18+ in the server name. - 1.5 If a community is 18+, underage users must be removed when discovered. - 1.6 Staff must not have a record of grooming or other predatory behavior. - 1.7 Do not provide false hub information (region, player count, server description, etc.). - 1.8 Do not abuse loopholes in hub rules or circumvent hub rulings.
### Section 2 (medium severity) - 2.1 Keep server name and description SFW and free from hate/discrimination. - 2.2 Do not impersonate other servers, developers, organizations, or affiliations. - 2.3 Do not intentionally cause technical trouble for players, servers, the hub, or communities.
### Section 3 (low severity) - 3.1 No advertising in the server name. The name should describe the game/server/community.
## Project clarifications - Staff has final say during rounds for rule interpretation. - Rule-lawyering and loophole abuse are prohibited. - Exploits, cheats, macros, and ban evasion are prohibited. - If a situation is unclear, stop escalation and contact staff.
